_README: Label id -> nerve tracked in the male's full-resolution cryosections (scripts/cryo/vhf_nerve_track.py + vhf_nerve_volume.py). A KEY, not data.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), male cryosections at full resolution (0.33 mm) via the NCI Imaging Data Commons, re-streamed by scripts/cryo/vhm_stream_leg_crops.py and read through the Q173 photograph-to-atlas registration. Derived data (scripts/cryo/vhm_femoral_popliteal_track.py).
